seo.title: Best Brunch Spots in Antwerp (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Antwerp's top brunch spots for 2026! From cozy cafes to stylish bistros, explore local favorites, classic dishes, and unique culinary experiences in Belgium's vibrant city.

hero.subtitle: Antwerp's brunch scene is a delicious blend of traditional Belgian charm and modern culinary innovation, offering everything from classic liege waffles to innovative plant-based spreads in historic settings and trendy neighborhoods.

picks.name: Maurice Coffee & Brunch
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled in the heart of the historic center, Maurice is renowned for its vibrant, Instagram-worthy brunch creations. They focus on fresh, seasonal ingredients, offering an extensive menu from elaborate pancake stacks to savory egg dishes and smoothie bowls in a chic, bustling setting. It's a quintessential Antwerp brunch experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Maurice Brunch Plate' or 'Pistachio Pancakes' for a sweet treat.
picks.insiderTip: Go early on weekends or be prepared for a short wait, as it's a very popular spot. They don't take reservations for small groups.
picks.redditQuote: "Maurice Coffee & Brunch is just fantastic. Their pancake stacks are insane, and everything just tastes so fresh. Definitely my go-to for brunch in Antwerp!"

picks.name: Standard
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Standard is a beloved brunch institution in the picturesque Zurenborg district, known for its American-inspired comfort food with a gourmet twist. Their menu features fluffy pancakes, perfectly poached eggs, and hearty sandwiches in a relaxed, retro-cool atmosphere. It's the ideal spot for a leisurely weekend brunch with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Eggs Benedict' or 'Buttermilk Pancakes' with crispy bacon.
picks.insiderTip: After brunch, take a stroll through the Zurenborg neighborhood to admire its stunning Art Nouveau architecture.
picks.redditQuote: "Can't beat Standard for a classic brunch. Their Eggs Benedict are always spot on, and the vibe is super chill. Definitely worth the tram ride to Zurenborg."

picks.name: Tinsel
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tinsel is a haven for plant-based eaters and health-conscious foodies. This cozy cafe offers an entirely vegetarian and largely vegan menu, focusing on inventive and delicious dishes made from fresh, organic ingredients. From vibrant smoothie bowls to savory toasts and vegan pastries, it's a refreshing take on brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Toast with Dukkah' or a seasonal 'Vegan Brunch Bowl'.
picks.insiderTip: They often have unique homemade vegan cakes and pastries – don't miss trying one with your coffee.
picks.redditQuote: "Tinsel is a dream for vegans! Their menu is so creative, and everything tastes amazing. The avocado toast is seriously next level good. Love that place."

picks.name: Piaf
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Piaf brings a touch of Parisian elegance to Antwerp's 't Zuid district. This stylish bistro offers a sophisticated brunch experience with French-inspired dishes, from delicate pastries and quiches to elaborate tartines and perfectly brewed coffee. The chic decor and attentive service make it perfect for a special occasion.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Piaf Brunch' for a comprehensive selection or a classic 'Croque Monsieur'.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially for weekend brunch, to secure a table at this popular spot.
picks.redditQuote: "Piaf is my absolute favorite for a fancy brunch. The atmosphere is gorgeous, and their pastries are divine. Feels like a little piece of Paris in Antwerp."

picks.name: Wasbar
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Wasbar combines a laundromat with a trendy brunch spot, offering a unique and relaxed atmosphere. While you wait for your laundry, you can enjoy creative bagel sandwiches, fresh juices, and classic breakfast items. It's a quirky and practical spot for a casual and affordable brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their signature loaded bagels, like the 'Mr. Salmon'.
picks.insiderTip: They have multiple locations in Antwerp; the one in Theaterbuurt is particularly spacious and lively.
picks.redditQuote: "Wasbar is such a cool concept! I get my laundry done and grab a delicious bagel and coffee. Their bagels are seriously good, especially the sweet ones."

picks.name: Konditori
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Konditori brings the hygge of Scandinavian culture to Antwerp. This cozy cafe and bakery specializes in delicious pastries, artisanal breads, and simple yet satisfying breakfast and brunch dishes. Their focus is on quality ingredients and a welcoming, minimalist ambiance, perfect for a peaceful start to your day.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Kanelbulle' (cinnamon bun) with a perfectly brewed filter coffee.
picks.insiderTip: Try their sourdough bread, which is baked fresh daily and makes excellent toast.
picks.redditQuote: "Konditori is a little slice of heaven. Their cinnamon buns are addictive, and the coffee is always excellent. Such a chill spot for a quiet brunch."

picks.name: Butcher's Coffee
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Butcher's Coffee is an Australian-inspired coffee bar famous for its exceptional coffee and delicious, no-nonsense breakfast and brunch. They serve up classic brunch staples like avocado toast and scrambled eggs with a focus on quality ingredients and friendly service in a vibrant, urban setting.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Smash' with a flat white, of course!
picks.insiderTip: It's a popular spot for remote workers during weekdays, offering good Wi-Fi and a productive atmosphere.
picks.redditQuote: "If you're serious about your coffee AND your brunch, Butcher's is the place. Their avocado toast is always perfect, and the baristas really know their stuff."

picks.name: Barnini
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Barnini is a casual, lively cafe popular for its wide selection of bagels, creative waffles, and milkshakes. It's a vibrant, youth-friendly spot perfect for a quick, delicious, and budget-friendly brunch in the city center. Their extensive menu ensures there's something for everyone, from sweet to savory.
picks.whatToOrder: One of their famous waffles, either sweet with fruit or savory with cheese and ham.
picks.insiderTip: Barnini is known for its milkshakes, which come in a huge variety of flavors – a fun treat alongside your brunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Barnini is my go-to for a quick, tasty, and cheap brunch. Their waffles are huge and delicious, and the bagels hit the spot every time. Always busy though!"

picks.name: Mali
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located in the trendy Eilandje district, Mali offers a bright and airy space focused on healthy and delicious brunch options. They excel in vibrant smoothie bowls, loaded toasts, and fresh juices, making it an ideal choice for those seeking nutritious and beautifully presented food in a modern setting.
picks.whatToOrder: A colorful 'Acai Bowl' or the 'Halloumi & Hummus Toast'.
picks.insiderTip: After brunch, explore the nearby MAS (Museum aan de Stroom) for stunning city views and cultural insights.
picks.redditQuote: "Mali has the best smoothie bowls in Antwerp, hands down. Everything is so fresh and feels good for you. Plus, the Eilandje area is great for a walk afterwards."

picks.name: L'Officina
picks.whyItMadeTheList: L'Officina brings an Italian flair to the Antwerp brunch scene, offering a menu that fuses classic breakfast items with Mediterranean influences. Expect delicious Italian pastries, savory frittatas, and fresh pasta dishes, all served in a stylish, industrial-chic setting. It's a sophisticated choice for an Italian-inspired brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Uova strapazzate' (scrambled eggs) with a side of focaccia or a 'Granola con Frutta'.
picks.insiderTip: They often have daily specials using seasonal ingredients, so ask your server for recommendations.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Officina's brunch is a hidden gem. Love their Italian twist on breakfast, and the coffee is excellent. The decor is really cool too, very sleek."

picks.name: Nordica 31
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nordica 31 is another excellent spot bringing Scandinavian charm to Antwerp. They offer a delightful range of open-faced sandwiches (smørrebrød), homemade pastries, and robust coffee in a bright, minimalist space. It's perfect for a light, wholesome, and aesthetically pleasing brunch experience.
picks.whatToOrder: A selection of 'Smørrebrød' for a true Scandinavian taste.
picks.insiderTip: Their cinnamon and cardamom buns are freshly baked and sell out quickly, so arrive early for the best selection.
picks.redditQuote: "Nordica 31 has such good smørrebrød! It's refreshing to have something different for brunch, and everything is always so fresh and beautifully presented. Great coffee too."

picks.name: Mirlo's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mirlo's is a relatively new but rapidly popular spot in 't Zuid, known for its creative and beautifully plated brunch dishes. Their menu is eclectic, blending European influences with fresh, seasonal ingredients to create unique flavor combinations. The bright, airy interior and friendly service make it a delightful experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Shakshuka' or a rotating 'Seasonal Brunch Plate'.
picks.insiderTip: They also have a fantastic selection of natural wines, making it a great spot if you fancy a mimosa or bellini with your brunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Heard about Mirlo's from a local and it didn't disappoint! Their brunch menu is so interesting and everything tasted incredible. Definitely a new favorite in 't Zuid."

faq.question: What is the average price for brunch in Antwerp?
faq.answer: The average price for brunch in Antwerp typically ranges from €15 to €30 per person ($16-$33 USD), depending on the venue and the dishes you order. Some more upscale or all-you-can-eat options might be slightly higher, while smaller cafes offering pastries and coffee can be more budget-friendly.

faq.question: Do I need to make reservations for brunch in Antwerp?
faq.answer: For popular brunch spots, especially on weekends, making a reservation is highly recommended to avoid long wait times. Some cafes, particularly smaller ones, operate on a first-come, first-served basis, so it's best to arrive early. Checking the venue's website or calling ahead is always a good idea.

faq.question: Are there good vegan or vegetarian brunch options in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Yes, Antwerp has a fantastic selection of vegan and vegetarian-friendly brunch spots. Venues like Tinsel are entirely plant-based, while many others offer excellent vegetarian and often clearly marked vegan dishes. The city's culinary scene is increasingly catering to diverse dietary preferences.

faq.question: What are the typical brunch hours in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Brunch hours in Antwerp usually run from around 9:00 AM or 10:00 AM until 2:00 PM or 3:00 PM, especially on weekends. Weekday brunch options might be more limited to early lunch menus at some establishments, so always check the specific opening times of your chosen venue.

faq.question: What kind of food can I expect at an Antwerp brunch?
faq.answer: Antwerp brunch spots offer a diverse range of food. You can expect traditional Belgian elements like waffles and artisanal breads, alongside international favorites such as eggs Benedict, avocado toast, pancakes, and smoothie bowls. Many places also incorporate fresh, seasonal ingredients and specialty coffees.

faq.question: Which neighborhoods are best for finding brunch spots in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Some of the best neighborhoods for brunch in Antwerp include the Historisch Centrum (Historic Center) for classic and popular spots, 't Zuid for trendy and chic options, Zurenborg for picturesque settings, and Eilandje for modern and healthy cafes. Each area offers a unique atmosphere and selection of eateries.

methodology: Our selection for Antwerp's best brunch spots is based on extensive local research, analysis of diner reviews, and expert insights. We prioritize venues known for exceptional food quality, inviting atmosphere, unique offerings, and consistent service, ensuring a diverse range of experiences for every taste and budget.
